title: Evolution ledger record
description: One sanitized audit line. The ledger records that an event happened; it is never the state store, so no reading of the lifecycle depends on a record being here. `record_type` is the vocabulary of events this controller writes, and it is widened by the task that first writes a new one — a name reserved ahead of the operation only promises an event nothing emits.

revision.description: The commit the event turned on: an experiment's base at creation, the round's pinned candidate at a seal and again at the revision that leaves that candidate behind, the promotion revision when a promotion is decided or concluded.

detail.description: One bounded reason code authored by this package — a freeze trigger, a rejection reason, a batch outcome. Never material fetched from a feed.
